name: chatgpt-chrome-bridge
description: Give Codex context-isolated ChatGPT reasoning and exact-thread follow-ups through a signed-in Chrome profile.

interface.longDescription: Use your own signed-in ChatGPT account for standalone research, analysis, drafting, explicit file analysis and exact-chat follow-ups. ChatGPT receives only the prompt, authorized attachments and the selected chat history. The bridge runs background Chrome, supports concurrent jobs, preserves login state, retrieves generated files and cleans disposable caches. Compact status is the default; full diagnostics are available on request. Guided setup lets you choose your account and an optional default ChatGPT project. Stable GitHub updates are automatic.
defaultPrompt: Delegate a self-contained general research workstream to ChatGPT
Continue a completed ChatGPT answer with a follow-up
Ask ChatGPT to analyze an explicitly attached file
